Type: geometric print cotton cushion
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: printed cotton with a slubby weave
Colors: blush pink, dark teal, mustard yellow, cream
Shape: square, overlapping blocky rectangles framed by cream lines with small teal squares, distressed print texture, knife edges, compact
Feel: cheerful, warm, artistic
Goes with: teal or grey sofas, walnut wood, brass; mid-century or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Geo Print Cotton Decorative Throw Pillow, Soft and Stylish, 17" x 17", Blush
product.description: Bring mid-century flair into your home with retro prints and colors. Patterns of blush, green, gold and ivory add a cheerful, interesting update to couch, chair or bed. For a quick change-up, reverse it to the solid blush linen-look back. 17" x 17" Front: Cotton; Back: Polyster Polyester fiber-filled insert included Insert can be easily removed via a bottom zipper on the cover Wipe with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
